_source: Institutions the app emulator knows. 20 are Plaid's published Sandbox institutions list (plaid.com/docs/sandbox/institutions); ins_1 and ins_109513 and the full detail of ins_109512 are published sample rows on plaid.com/docs/api/institutions. Fetched 2026-10-20, not the pinned 2026-09-28 docs capture. Provisional: for Sandbox institutions the docs list by name only, products are a template copied from the ins_109512 sample, routing_numbers are empty, country is US unless the list says Canadian or UK, and names drop the docs' parenthetical notes. Production institutions (the docs say all of them also exist in Sandbox) are not included.
